mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sp_rules_library ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT rl.id as rl_id, rl.name as rl_name, rl.stream_ids as rl_stream_ids, rl.auth as rl_auth, rl.status as rl_status, rl."user" as rl_user, rl.source as rl_source, rl.description as rl_description, rl.created_user as rl_created_user, rl.update_time as rl_update_time,
rpl.id as rpl_id, rpl.pid as rpl_pid, rpl.stream_id as rpl_stream_id, rpl.branch_id as rpl_branch_id, rpl.file_id as rpl_file_id, rpl.status as rpl_status, rpl.update_time as rpl_update_time,
rd.id as rd_id, rd.pid as rd_pid, rd.name as rd_name, rd.description as rd_description, rd.status as rd_status, rd.icon as rd_icon,
rp.id as rp_id, rp.detail_id as rp_detail_id, rp.name as rp_name, rp.relation as rp_relation, rp.value1 as rp_value1, rp.value2 as rp_value2, rp.status as rp_status, rp.update_time as rp_update_time FROM sp_rules_library rl LEFT JOIN sp_rules_parameters_lod rpl ON rl.id = rpl.pid LEFT JOIN sp_rules_detail rd ON rl.id = rd.pid LEFT JOIN sp_rules_parameters rp ON rd.id = rp.detail_id WHERE rl.id = #{id}
